candidates.change_summary: Remove the `if(intitalized)revert();` guard so MinSum can still be set after initialization.
Remove the assignment so MinSum is never updated by SetMinSum.
Change the assignment to accumulate the value instead of overwriting MinSum.
Invert the guard condition so SetMinSum only succeeds after initialization.
Delete the assignment 'MinSum = _val;' so SetMinSum never updates MinSum.
Replace 'MinSum = _val;' with 'MinSum += _val;' so repeated calls accumulate instead of overwrite.
Remove the 'if(intitalized)revert();' guard so MinSum can be changed even after initialization.
Replace 'MinSum = _val;' with 'MinSum = _val + 1;' so the stored value is off by one.
Assign msg.sender instead of the _log parameter to the Log state variable, so the stored log address is the caller rather than the argument.
Delete the assignment to Log so the log address remains address(0) after calling SetLogFile.
Invert the initialization guard so the function only performs the assignment when already initialized, changing the Log value for sequences where SetLogFile is called after Initialized().
Delete the statement 'acc.balance += msg.value;' so deposits no longer increase the recorded balance.
Delete the statement that updates acc.unlockTime, so the lock time is never extended.
Replace the guarded unlock-time update with an unconditional assignment so subsequent shorter lock times lower acc.unlockTime.
Replace 'acc.balance += msg.value;' with 'acc.balance = msg.value;' so each deposit overwrites rather than accumulates the balance.
Delete the statement that decrements the holder's balance, so Collect pays out without updating acc.balance.
Replace the balance-decrement statement with acc.balance = _am, setting the balance to _am instead of subtracting _am.
Remove the unlock-time condition from the guard so Collect can succeed before acc.unlockTime.
